| Change type | Criterion | v1 | v2 | So what |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Modified | Fingerstick testing frequency (1.4) | Minimum of 3 tests per day | Minimum of 4 tests per day | Beneficiaries documented at 3 tests per day flip from covered to denied, so testing frequency becomes a live denial reason. |
| Added | Failure of prior therapy (1.7) | Not required | Inadequate glycemic control on a fingerstick-guided regimen over a trial of at least 3 months | New medical necessity gate, so first-line CGM requests with no documented trial now deny. |
| Added | Documentation of the prior therapy trial (3.5) | Not required | Records of the trial including the glycemic results establishing inadequate control | Even qualifying beneficiaries deny on documentation if the trial results are not in the file. |
| Modified | Revision and effective date | 1.0, effective January 1, 2025 | 2.0, effective July 1, 2025 | Dates of service on or after July 1, 2025 must be adjudicated against the stricter criteria. |
